title: GDPR personal data processing
description: Questions for the privacy owner and repository checks when a change processes personal data under Regulation (EU) 2016/679. Apply the organization's approved interpretation; these rules do not establish compliance.

sources.title: CNIL, Le registre des activités de traitement
CNIL, L'analyse d'impact relative à la protection des données (AIPD)
CNIL, Notifier une violation de données personnelles

rules.instruction: When the change creates or alters a processing of personal data, ask the privacy owner to update the record of processing activities (GDPR Art. 30) with the purpose, data categories, recipients and retention.
rules.verification: Link the updated entry of the record of processing activities from the change.

rules.instruction: Ask the privacy owner which lawful basis of Art. 6 covers each new purpose of processing, and record the answer in the processing record.
rules.verification: Check that the processing record names a lawful basis for each purpose the change introduces.

rules.instruction: Collect only the personal data fields that the recorded purpose needs (Art. 5(1)(c) and Art. 25(2)).
rules.verification: Compare the fields added to forms, schemas and logs with the purpose in the processing record, and list any field without a stated need.

rules.instruction: Ask the privacy owner for the retention period of the new data (Art. 5(1)(e)), and implement its deletion or anonymisation in the repository.
rules.verification: Find the deletion job, policy or test that applies the recorded retention period to the new data.

rules.instruction: Ask the data protection officer whether the change requires a data protection impact assessment under Art. 35, and record the decision with its reason.
rules.verification: Link the recorded decision or the completed assessment from the change.

rules.instruction: When a new service provider processes personal data for the organization, ask the legal owner to confirm a contract that meets Art. 28.
rules.verification: Check that the processing record names the provider and links the signed processing terms.

rules.instruction: When personal data leaves the European Economic Area, ask the legal owner which Chapter V mechanism applies (Art. 45 to 49), such as standard contractual clauses.
rules.verification: Check that the processing record names the destination country and the transfer mechanism.

rules.instruction: Make the new personal data reachable by the project's access, rectification and erasure procedures (Art. 15 to 17).
rules.verification: Run the export and erasure procedures on a test account and confirm that they return or remove the new data.

rules.instruction: Ask the privacy owner who assesses a personal data breach and notifies the supervisory authority within 72 hours where required (Art. 33), and record that person in the incident runbook.
rules.verification: Open the incident runbook and check that it names the person and the steps for Art. 33 and Art. 34.
